old_policy_reference_semantics: Each execution independently recomputes its own old-policy anchors from initial weights and then current scores; CPU does not freeze native old anchors.
clipping_semantics: Original torch clip_grad_norm_ return sets each path actual clipping factor; extra FP64 full-gradient norm is diagnostic and does not replace the native/CPU clipping algorithm.

publication_conditions.old_policy_semantics: Each execution independently recomputes its own old policy from the original checkpoint before current forward; CPU does not consume native anchors. Both initial ratios are one.
publication_conditions.objective: One complete GRPO group batch; per-sequence masked mean, then global batch mean. Nonzero group advantages and gradients may accompany zero summed initial loss.
publication_conditions.cpu_clip_factor: Actual torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_ uses its returned FP32 norm and max_norm/(returned_norm+1e-6), clamped at one. The separately calculated FP64 diagnostic norm is not used for clipping.
